why: Every note stands in the inside margin beside its verse. PTXprint moves crowded notes up and down within their page but cannot carry them to the next, so where a page's notes overrun its margin, the tallest of them are set below the text, as footnotes with callers, each keyed by the note, with the passage it relieves. The placements are made for the published typeface, Valkyrie, and measured in the unfilled proof: each reason gives a note's height and its page's overrun in lines of notes, with the notes the page sets below left in the margin. Filling moves text between pages, and the check that every note stands in its margin is made on the filled book too.
